            if (suppressServerSearchEvent) return;
            FilterServers(txtServerSearchBox.Text);
            if (cboServerDropdown.Items.Count > 0)
                cboServerDropdown.SelectedIndex = 0;
            else
                LoadSelectedServerPaks();
        }

        private void FilterServers(string query)
        {
            cboServerDropdown.Items.Clear();
            foreach (string server in cachedServerFolders)
            {
                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(query) || server.IndexOf(query, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0)
                {
                    cboServerDropdown.Items.Add(server);
                }
            }

            // Clearing the Items collection does not raise SelectedIndexChanged, so without
            // this the custom field could keep showing a server that has just been filtered
            // out from under it.
            UpdateDropDownDisplays();
        }

        private void LoadSelectedServerPaks()
        {
            try
            {
                cachedServerPaks.Clear();
                string serverName = (cboServerDropdown.SelectedItem != null) ? cboServerDropdown.SelectedItem.ToString() : null;

                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(serverName))
                {
                    string targetDir = Path.Combine(serverStorageDir, serverName);
                    if (Directory.Exists(targetDir))
                    {
                        foreach (string file in Directory.GetFiles(targetDir, "*.pak"))
                        {
                            cachedServerPaks.Add(Path.GetFileName(file));
                        }
                    }
                }

                FilterMods(txtModSearchBox.Text);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                ShowError("Listing Mod Files for Selected Server", ex);
            }
        }

        private void OnModSearchChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            if (suppressModSearchEvent) return;
            FilterMods(txtModSearchBox.Text);
        }

        private void FilterMods(string query)
        {
            lstServerPaks.Items.Clear();
            foreach (string pak in cachedServerPaks)
            {
                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(query) || pak.IndexOf(query, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0)
                {
                    lstServerPaks.Items.Add(pak);
                }
            }
        }

        private void OnAddServerClicked(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            string name = ShowThemedInputBox("Enter the new server folder name:", "Add Server", "");
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name))
            {
                try
                {
                    string trimmedName = name.Trim();
                    if (trimmedName.Equals("Backup_Vanilla", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                        trimmedName.Equals("Backup_Saves", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                        trimmedName.Equals("Backup_CharacterSaves", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                        trimmedName.Equals("UndoCache", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        ShowThemedMessage("Invalid Name", "That name is reserved for system backups.");
                        return;
                    }

                    Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.Combine(serverStorageDir, trimmedName));
                    txtServerSearchBox.Text = "";
                    RefreshServerList();
                    cboServerDropdown.SelectedItem = trimmedName;
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    ShowError("Creating New Server Folder", ex);
                }
            }
        }

        private void OnDeleteServerClicked(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            string serverName = (cboServerDropdown.SelectedItem != null) ? cboServerDropdown.SelectedItem.ToString() : "";
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(serverName))
            {
                ShowThemedMessage("Notice", "Please select a server folder to delete.");
                return;
            }

            string serverDirPath = Path.Combine(serverStorageDir, serverName);

            if (ShowThemedConfirm("Confirm Delete Server", "Are you sure you want to delete the entire server folder '" + serverName + "' and all its stored mod paks?") == DialogResult.Yes)
            {
                try
                {
                    if (Directory.Exists(serverDirPath))
                    {
                        // Moved into undoCacheDir rather than actually deleted, so Undo can put
                        // it back. The unique suffix avoids colliding with an earlier deletion
                        // of a same-named folder still sitting in the cache.
                        string cachedPath = Path.Combine(undoCacheDir, serverName + "_" + DateTime.Now.Ticks);
                        Directory.Move(serverDirPath, cachedPath);
                        undoHistory.Push(new UndoEntry { Type = UndoActionType.DeletedServerFolder, OriginalPath = serverDirPath, CachedPath = cachedPath, ServerName = serverName });
                        // A fresh deletion starts a new branch of history - any previously
                        // undone deletions sitting in redoHistory no longer apply.
                        redoHistory.Clear();
                        UpdateUndoButtonState();
                        RefreshServerList();
                        ShowThemedMessage("Success", "Successfully deleted server folder '" + serverName + "'. You can Undo this until you close ModManager.");
                    }
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    ShowError("Deleting Server Folder", ex);
                }
            }
        }

        private void OnDeleteModClicked(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            if (lstServerPaks.SelectedItem == null)
            {
                ShowThemedMessage("Notice", "Please select a .pak file from the list to delete.");
                return;
            }

            string serverName = (cboServerDropdown.SelectedItem != null) ? cboServerDropdown.SelectedItem.ToString() : "";
            string fileName = lstServerPaks.SelectedItem.ToString();
            string filePath = Path.Combine(serverStorageDir, serverName, fileName);

            if (ShowThemedConfirm("Confirm Delete", "Are you sure you want to delete '" + fileName + "'?") == DialogResult.Yes)
            {
                try
                {
                    if (File.Exists(filePath))
                    {
                        string cachedPath = Path.Combine(undoCacheDir, fileName + "_" + DateTime.Now.Ticks);
                        File.Move(filePath, cachedPath);
                        undoHistory.Push(new UndoEntry { Type = UndoActionType.DeletedModFile, OriginalPath = filePath, CachedPath = cachedPath, ServerName = serverName });
                        // A fresh deletion starts a new branch of history - any previously
                        // undone deletions sitting in redoHistory no longer apply.
                        redoHistory.Clear();
                        UpdateUndoButtonState();
                        LoadSelectedServerPaks();
                        ShowThemedMessage("Success", "Successfully deleted '" + fileName + "'. You can Undo this until you close ModManager.");
                    }
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    ShowError("Deleting Selected Mod File", ex);
                }
            }
        }

        // Pops the most recent deletion off undoHistory and moves the file/folder back from
        // undoCacheDir to where it came from. Calling this repeatedly keeps walking back
        // through every deletion made this session, oldest ones included, one click at a time.
        private void OnUndoLastActionClicked(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            if (undoHistory.Count == 0)
            {
                ShowThemedMessage("Nothing To Undo", "There are no recent mod or server deletions to undo.");
                return;
            }

            UndoEntry entry = undoHistory.Pop();
            try
            {
                if (entry.Type == UndoActionType.DeletedServerFolder)
                {
                    if (Directory.Exists(entry.CachedPath) && !Directory.Exists(entry.OriginalPath))
                    {
                        Directory.Move(entry.CachedPath, entry.OriginalPath);
                    }
                    RefreshServerList();
                    if (cboServerDropdown.Items.Contains(entry.ServerName))
                    {
                        cboServerDropdown.SelectedItem = entry.ServerName;
                    }
                }
                else if (entry.Type == UndoActionType.DeletedModFile)
                {
                    if (File.Exists(entry.CachedPath) && !File.Exists(entry.OriginalPath))
                    {
                        File.Move(entry.CachedPath, entry.OriginalPath);
                    }
                    string currentServer = (cboServerDropdown.SelectedItem != null) ? cboServerDropdown.SelectedItem.ToString() : "";
                    if (string.Equals(currentServer, entry.ServerName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        LoadSelectedServerPaks();
                    }
                }

                // The restore succeeded - hand this entry to Redo so it can re-delete it.
                redoHistory.Push(entry);
                UpdateUndoButtonState();
                ShowThemedMessage("Undo Complete", "Restored: " + Path.GetFileName(entry.OriginalPath));
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                ShowError("Undoing Last Change", ex);
            }
        }

        // Pops the most recently undone deletion off redoHistory and re-deletes it (moves it
        // back out into undoCacheDir), then pushes it back onto undoHistory so it can be
        // undone again if needed. Mirrors OnUndoLastActionClicked in reverse.
        private void OnRedoLastActionClicked(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            if (redoHistory.Count == 0)
            {
                ShowThemedMessage("Nothing To Redo", "There are no undone deletions to redo.");
                return;
            }

            UndoEntry entry = redoHistory.Pop();
            try
            {
                if (entry.Type == UndoActionType.DeletedServerFolder)
                {
                    if (Directory.Exists(entry.OriginalPath) && !Directory.Exists(entry.CachedPath))
                    {
                        Directory.Move(entry.OriginalPath, entry.CachedPath);
                    }
                    RefreshServerList();
                }
                else if (entry.Type == UndoActionType.DeletedModFile)
                {
                    if (File.Exists(entry.OriginalPath) && !File.Exists(entry.CachedPath))
                    {
                        File.Move(entry.OriginalPath, entry.CachedPath);
                    }
                    string currentServer = (cboServerDropdown.SelectedItem != null) ? cboServerDropdown.SelectedItem.ToString() : "";
                    if (string.Equals(currentServer, entry.ServerName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        LoadSelectedServerPaks();
                    }
                }

                undoHistory.Push(entry);
                UpdateUndoButtonState();
                ShowThemedMessage("Redo Complete", "Re-deleted: " + Path.GetFileName(entry.OriginalPath));
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                // Put it back so a failed redo doesn't just vanish from history.
                redoHistory.Push(entry);
                ShowError("Redoing Last Change", ex);
            }
        }

        private void UpdateUndoButtonState()
        {
            if (btnUndoLastAction == null) return;
            btnUndoLastAction.Enabled = undoHistory.Count > 0;
            btnUndoLastAction.Text = undoHistory.Count > 0 ? "Undo (" + undoHistory.Count + ")" : "Undo";
        }

        // Deleting a mod/server only moves it into undoCacheDir, so as long as anything is
        // still sitting in there uncommitted, closing the app is the one action that actually
        // and permanently throws it away. Warn before that happens.
        private void OnModManagerFormClosing(object sender, FormClosingEventArgs e)
        {
            if (undoHistory.Count > 0)
            {
                int pendingCount = undoHistory.Count;
                DialogResult result = ShowThemedConfirm(
                    "Unsaved Changes",
                    "There " + (pendingCount == 1 ? "is 1 deletion" : "are " + pendingCount + " deletions") +
                    " you could still Undo. Closing ModManager will permanently clear that undo history and cannot be undone.\n\nAre you sure you want to close?");

                if (result != DialogResult.Yes)
                {
                    e.Cancel = true;
                    return;
                }
            }

            try
            {
                if (Directory.Exists(undoCacheDir))
                {
                    Directory.Delete(undoCacheDir, true);
                }
            }
            catch { }
        }

        private void OnMergeServerModsClicked(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            if (cachedServerFolders.Count < 2)
            {
                ShowThemedMessage("Insufficient Servers", "You need at least two server folders to perform a merge.");
                return;
            }

            Form mergeForm = new Form
            {
                Text = "Merge Server Mods",
                Width = 720,
                Height = 560,
                StartPosition = FormStartPosition.CenterParent,
                MinimizeBox = false,
                MaximizeBox = false
            };

            // Labels are positioned first, then each combo box is placed relative to the
            // *measured* right edge of its label (label.Right), rather than a hardcoded pixel
            // offset. Bold "Second Server:" doesn't render at a fixed width across DPI
            // settings/font substitutions, so a fixed gap previously let the label text run
            // into the combo box next to it. Measuring at runtime guarantees a fixed gap that
            // can never overlap.
            const int labelToComboGap = 8;
            const int comboToNextLabelGap = 20;

            Label lblServer1 = new Label { Text = "First Server:", Location = new Point(15, 15), AutoSize = true, Font = new Font(FontFamily.GenericSansSerif, 9, FontStyle.Bold) };
            ComboBox cboServer1 = new ComboBox { Location = new Point(lblServer1.Right + labelToComboGap, 12), Width = 190, DropDownStyle = ComboBoxStyle.DropDownList };

            Label lblServer2 = new Label { Text = "Second Server:", Location = new Point(cboServer1.Right + comboToNextLabelGap, 15), AutoSize = true, Font = new Font(FontFamily.GenericSansSerif, 9, FontStyle.Bold) };
            ComboBox cboServer2 = new ComboBox { Location = new Point(lblServer2.Right + labelToComboGap, 12), Width = 190, DropDownStyle = ComboBoxStyle.DropDownList };

            foreach (string s in cachedServerFolders)
            {
                cboServer1.Items.Add(s);
                cboServer2.Items.Add(s);
            }

            if (cboServer1.Items.Count > 0) cboServer1.SelectedIndex = 0;
            if (cboServer2.Items.Count > 1) cboServer2.SelectedIndex = 1;
            else if (cboServer2.Items.Count > 0) cboServer2.SelectedIndex = 0;

            CheckedListBox chkListLeft = new CheckedListBox { Location = new Point(15, 50), Size = new Size(320, 380), CheckOnClick = true, Anchor = AnchorStyles.Top | AnchorStyles.Bottom | AnchorStyles.Left };
            CheckedListBox chkListRight = new CheckedListBox { Location = new Point(365, 50), Size = new Size(320, 380), CheckOnClick = true, Anchor = AnchorStyles.Top | AnchorStyles.Bottom | AnchorStyles.Right };

            Action loadLeftPaks = delegate
            {
                chkListLeft.Items.Clear();
                string sName = cboServer1.SelectedItem as string;
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(sName))
                {
                    string dir = Path.Combine(serverStorageDir, sName);
                    if (Directory.Exists(dir))
                    {
                        foreach (string f in Directory.GetFiles(dir, "*.pak"))
                        {
                            chkListLeft.Items.Add(Path.GetFileName(f), true);
                        }
                    }
                }
            };

            Action loadRightPaks = delegate
            {
                chkListRight.Items.Clear();
                string sName = cboServer2.SelectedItem as string;
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(sName))
                {
                    string dir = Path.Combine(serverStorageDir, sName);
                    if (Directory.Exists(dir))
                    {
                        foreach (string f in Directory.GetFiles(dir, "*.pak"))
                        {
                            chkListRight.Items.Add(Path.GetFileName(f), true);
                        }
                    }
                }
            };

            cboServer1.SelectedIndexChanged += delegate { loadLeftPaks(); };
            cboServer2.SelectedIndexChanged += delegate { loadRightPaks(); };

            loadLeftPaks();
            loadRightPaks();

            Button btnExecuteMerge = new ShinyButton
            {
                Text = "Execute Merge/Create New Server",
                Location = new Point(15, 450),
                Width = 670,
                Height = 36,
                FlatStyle = FlatStyle.Flat,
                Anchor = AnchorStyles.Bottom | AnchorStyles.Left | AnchorStyles.Right,
                Font = new Font(FontFamily.GenericSansSerif, 9.5f, FontStyle.Bold)
            };

            btnExecuteMerge.Click += delegate
            {
                string newServerName = ShowThemedInputBox("Enter name for the new merged server folder:", "New Server Name", "MergedServer");
                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(newServerName)) return;

                string trimmedName = newServerName.Trim();
                if (trimmedName.Equals("Backup_Vanilla", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                    trimmedName.Equals("Backup_Saves", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                    trimmedName.Equals("Backup_CharacterSaves", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                    trimmedName.Equals("UndoCache", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    ShowThemedMessage("Invalid Name", "That name is reserved for system backups.");
                    return;
                }

                string newServerDirPath = Path.Combine(serverStorageDir, trimmedName);
                if (Directory.Exists(newServerDirPath))
                {
                    ShowThemedMessage("Error", "A server folder with that name already exists.");
                    return;
                }

                try
                {
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(newServerDirPath);
                    Dictionary<string, string> uniqueMods = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

                    string s1Dir = Path.Combine(serverStorageDir, cboServer1.SelectedItem.ToString());
                    foreach (var item in chkListLeft.CheckedItems)
                    {
                        string fileName = item.ToString();
                        string sourcePath = Path.Combine(s1Dir, fileName);
                        string baseName = ExtractBaseModName(fileName);

                        if (uniqueMods.ContainsKey(baseName))
                        {
                            string existingPath = uniqueMods[baseName];
                            DateTime existingDate = File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(existingPath);
                            DateTime incomingDate = File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(sourcePath);
                            if (incomingDate > existingDate)
                            {
                                uniqueMods[baseName] = sourcePath;
                            }
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            uniqueMods[baseName] = sourcePath;
                        }
                    }

                    string s2Dir = Path.Combine(serverStorageDir, cboServer2.SelectedItem.ToString());
                    foreach (var item in chkListRight.CheckedItems)
                    {
                        string fileName = item.ToString();
                        string sourcePath = Path.Combine(s2Dir, fileName);
                        string baseName = ExtractBaseModName(fileName);

                        if (uniqueMods.ContainsKey(baseName))
                        {
                            string existingPath = uniqueMods[baseName];
                            DateTime existingDate = File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(existingPath);
                            DateTime incomingDate = File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(sourcePath);
                            if (incomingDate > existingDate)
                            {
                                uniqueMods[baseName] = sourcePath;
                            }
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            uniqueMods[baseName] = sourcePath;
                        }
                    }

                    int copiedCount = 0;
                    foreach (var kvp in uniqueMods)
                    {
                        string src = kvp.Value;
                        string dest = Path.Combine(newServerDirPath, Path.GetFileName(src));
                        File.Copy(src, dest, true);
                        copiedCount++;
                    }

                    RefreshServerList();
                    cboServerDropdown.SelectedItem = trimmedName;
                    mergeForm.Close();
                    ShowThemedMessage("Merge Complete", "Successfully created merged server '" + trimmedName + "' with " + copiedCount + " unique/updated mod(s).");
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    ShowError("Merging Server Mods", ex);
                }
            };

            mergeForm.Controls.Add(lblServer1);
            mergeForm.Controls.Add(cboServer1);
            mergeForm.Controls.Add(lblServer2);
            mergeForm.Controls.Add(cboServer2);
            mergeForm.Controls.Add(chkListLeft);
            mergeForm.Controls.Add(chkListRight);
            mergeForm.Controls.Add(btnExecuteMerge);

            ApplyDialogTheme(mergeForm);
            bool mergeUseDarkScrollbar = GetThemeColors(CurrentThemeName()).UseDarkScrollbar;
            ApplyNativeScrollbarTheme(chkListLeft, mergeUseDarkScrollbar);
            ApplyNativeScrollbarTheme(chkListRight, mergeUseDarkScrollbar);
            mergeForm.ShowDialog(this);
        }

        private string ExtractBaseModName(string filename)
        {
            string name = Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(filename);

            if (name.EndsWith("_P", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                name = name.Substring(0, name.Length - 2);
            }

            name = Regex.Replace(name, @"^[zZ]+_?", "", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);
            name = Regex.Replace(name, @"[_\-\.]?v?\d+[\d\.\-T_r]*$", "", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);

            return name.ToLower().Trim();
        }

        private bool IsReadmeFile(string fileName)
        {
            string fileNameOnly = Path.GetFileName(fileName);
            return Regex.IsMatch(fileNameOnly, @"^.*read.*m*e*.*\.(txt|md|rtf|log)$", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase) || 
                   Regex.IsMatch(fileNameOnly, @"^readme.*$", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);
        }

        private void OnPanelDragEnter(object sender, DragEventArgs e)
        {
            if (e.Data.GetDataPresent(DataFormats.FileDrop) || 
                e.Data.GetDataPresent("FileGroupDescriptorW"))
            {
                e.Effect = DragDropEffects.Copy;
                ShowDragOverlay();
            }
            else
            {
                e.Effect = DragDropEffects.None;
            }
        }

        private void AnyControl_DragLeave(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            // Debounced: moving from one child control to another fires DragLeave on the first
            // immediately followed by DragEnter on the second within the same message pump, so
            // delay the hide briefly and let a fresh DragEnter cancel it - avoids overlay flicker
            // while dragging across the window instead of only truly leaving it.
            dragLeaveTimer.Stop();
            dragLeaveTimer.Start();
        }

        private void ShowDragOverlay()
        {
            dragLeaveTimer.Stop();
            if (!pnlDragOverlay.Visible)
            {
                pnlDragOverlay.Visible = true;
                pnlDragOverlay.BringToFront();
            }
            Opacity = 0.88;
        }

        private void HideDragOverlay()
        {
            pnlDragOverlay.Visible = false;
            Opacity = 1.0;
        }

        private void OnPanelDragDrop(object sender, DragEventArgs e)
        {
            dragLeaveTimer.Stop();
            HideDragOverlay();

            string serverName = (cboServerDropdown.SelectedItem != null) ? cboServerDropdown.SelectedItem.ToString() : null;

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(serverName))
            {
                serverName = ShowThemedInputBox("Enter target server name for these files:", "New Server", "");
                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(serverName)) return;

                try
                {
                    string trimmedName = serverName.Trim();
                    if (trimmedName.Equals("Backup_Vanilla", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                        trimmedName.Equals("Backup_Saves", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                        trimmedName.Equals("Backup_CharacterSaves", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                        trimmedName.Equals("UndoCache", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        ShowThemedMessage("Invalid Name", "That name is reserved for system backups.");
                        return;
                    }

                    Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.Combine(serverStorageDir, trimmedName));
                    txtServerSearchBox.Text = "";
                    RefreshServerList();
                    cboServerDropdown.SelectedItem = trimmedName;
                    serverName = trimmedName;
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    ShowError("Creating Target Server Directory", ex);
                    return;
                }
            }

            string targetServerPath = Path.Combine(serverStorageDir, serverName);
            int processedCount = 0;
            string tempExtractDir = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "MotorTownModManager_" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N"));

            try
            {
                List<string> filesToProcess = new List<string>();

                // Handle Standard Physical File Drops (.zip, .pak, loose files) - checked first.
                // Explorer commonly advertises "FileGroupDescriptorW" even for ordinary files
                // dragged straight off disk, not just genuine virtual sources (e.g. dragging
                // out of an open zip-preview window). If we checked that format first, real
                // file drops would get routed into the virtual-stream path, which can't
                // retrieve their actual content - so nothing gets imported. Checking FileDrop
                // first ensures normal drags are handled the reliable, direct way.
                if (e.Data.GetDataPresent(DataFormats.FileDrop))
                {
                    string[] paths = (string[])e.Data.GetData(DataFormats.FileDrop);

                    foreach (string path in paths)
                    {
                        if (File.Exists(path))
                        {
                            string fileName = Path.GetFileName(path);
                            string ext = Path.GetExtension(path);

                            if (ext.Equals(".pak", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                            {
                                filesToProcess.Add(path);
                            }
                            else if (IsReadmeFile(fileName))
                            {
                                try
                                {
                                    ShowReadmeWindow(fileName, File.ReadAllText(path));
                                }
                                catch (Exception ex)
                                {
                                    ShowError("Reading Loose Readme File '" + fileName + "'", ex);
                                }
                            }
                            else if (ext.Equals(".zip", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                            {
                                try
                                {
                                    Directory.CreateDirectory(tempExtractDir);
                                    SafeExtractZip(path, tempExtractDir);

                                    foreach (string extractedFile in Directory.GetFiles(tempExtractDir, "*", SearchOption.AllDirectories))
                                    {
                                        string extractedFileName = Path.GetFileName(extractedFile);
                                        string extractedExt = Path.GetExtension(extractedFile);

                                        if (IsReadmeFile(extractedFileName))
                                        {
                                            try { ShowReadmeWindow(extractedFileName, File.ReadAllText(extractedFile)); } catch { }
                                        }
                                        else if (extractedFileName.Equals("Engine.ini", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) && chkAutoEngineIni.Checked)
                                        {
                                            ProcessEngineIni(extractedFile);
                                        }
                                        else if (extractedExt.Equals(".pak", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                                        {
                                            if (!filesToProcess.Contains(extractedFile))
                                            {
                                                filesToProcess.Add(extractedFile);
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                                catch (Exception ex)
                                {
                                    ShowError("Extracting Zip Archive '" + Path.GetFileName(path) + "'", ex);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                // Handle Virtual File Stream Drops (dragging files directly out of an open Zip
                // window) - only reached when this isn't a normal physical file drop.
                else if (e.Data.GetDataPresent("FileGroupDescriptorW") && e.Data.GetDataPresent("FileContents"))
                {
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(tempExtractDir);
                    Stream stream = (Stream)e.Data.GetData("FileGroupDescriptorW");
                    if (stream != null)
                    {
                        byte[] buffer = new byte[stream.Length];
                        stream.Read(buffer, 0, buffer.Length);

                        int fileCount = BitConverter.ToInt32(buffer, 0);
                        int offset = 4;

                        for (int i = 0; i < fileCount; i++)
                        {
                            string fileName = System.Text.Encoding.Unicode.GetString(buffer, offset + 76, 520).TrimEnd('\0');
                            offset += 592; // Size of FILEDESCRIPTORW structure

                            byte[] fileBytes = GetVirtualFileContents(e.Data, i);
                            if (fileBytes != null)
                            {
                                string extractedFilePath = SafeCombineWithinDirectory(tempExtractDir, fileName);
                                if (extractedFilePath == null)
                                {
                                    continue; // suspicious/unsafe name in virtual drop data - skip it
                                }
                                File.WriteAllBytes(extractedFilePath, fileBytes);

                                string ext = Path.GetExtension(extractedFilePath);
                                if (ext.Equals(".pak", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                                {
                                    filesToProcess.Add(extractedFilePath);
                                }
                                else if (IsReadmeFile(fileName))
                                {
                                    try { ShowReadmeWindow(fileName, File.ReadAllText(extractedFilePath)); } catch { }
                                }
                                else if (ext.Equals(".zip", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                                {
                                    try
                                    {
                                        string innerExtractDir = Path.Combine(tempExtractDir, "inner_" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N"));
                                        Directory.CreateDirectory(innerExtractDir);
                                        SafeExtractZip(extractedFilePath, innerExtractDir);

                                        foreach (string extractedFile in Directory.GetFiles(innerExtractDir, "*", SearchOption.AllDirectories))
                                        {
                                            string innerFileName = Path.GetFileName(extractedFile);
                                            string innerExt = Path.GetExtension(extractedFile);

                                            if (IsReadmeFile(innerFileName))
                                            {
                                                try { ShowReadmeWindow(innerFileName, File.ReadAllText(extractedFile)); } catch { }
                                            }
                                            else if (innerFileName.Equals("Engine.ini", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) && chkAutoEngineIni.Checked)
                                            {
                                                ProcessEngineIni(extractedFile);
                                            }
                                            else if (innerExt.Equals(".pak", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                                            {
                                                if (!filesToProcess.Contains(extractedFile))
                                                {
                                                    filesToProcess.Add(extractedFile);
                                                }
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                    catch (Exception ex)
                                    {
                                        ShowError("Extracting Dropped Zip Archive '" + fileName + "'", ex);
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                foreach (string file in filesToProcess)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        string incomingFileName = Path.GetFileName(file);

                        if (incomingFileName.Equals("MotorTown-Windows.pak", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        {
                            continue;
                        }

                        if (!chkSmartMatching.Checked)
                        {
                            File.Copy(file, Path.Combine(targetServerPath, incomingFileName), true);
                            processedCount++;
                            continue;
                        }

                        string incomingBaseName = ExtractBaseModName(incomingFileName);
                        string[] existingFiles = Directory.GetFiles(targetServerPath, "*.pak");
                        string matchPath = null;

                        foreach (string existing in existingFiles)
                        {
                            if (ExtractBaseModName(Path.GetFileName(existing)) == incomingBaseName)
                            {
                                matchPath = existing;
                                break;
                            }
                        }

                        if (matchPath != null)
                        {
                            string existingFileName = Path.GetFileName(matchPath);

                            if (existingFileName.Equals(incomingFileName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                            {
                                File.Copy(file, Path.Combine(targetServerPath, incomingFileName), true);
                                processedCount++;
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                DateTime existingDate = File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(matchPath);
                                DateTime incomingDate = File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(file);

                                string comparisonNote = incomingDate > existingDate
                                    ? "• NEW file is newer (Modified: " + incomingDate.ToLocalTime() + ")\n  than existing file (Modified: " + existingDate.ToLocalTime() + ")"
                                    : "• NEW file is older or same (Modified: " + incomingDate.ToLocalTime() + ")\n  than existing file (Modified: " + existingDate.ToLocalTime() + ")";

                                string prompt = "Existing version of this mod detected:\n\n" +
                                                "Existing: " + existingFileName + "\n" +
                                                "Incoming: " + incomingFileName + "\n\n" +
                                                "File Properties:\n" + comparisonNote + "\n\n" +
                                                "Replace old version with the new one?";

                                if (ShowThemedConfirm("Version Conflict Detected", prompt) == DialogResult.Yes)
                                {
                                    File.Delete(matchPath);
                                    File.Copy(file, Path.Combine(targetServerPath, incomingFileName), true);
                                    processedCount++;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            File.Copy(file, Path.Combine(targetServerPath, incomingFileName), true);
                            processedCount++;
                        }
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        ShowError("Processing File '" + Path.GetFileName(file) + "'", ex);
                    }
                }
            }
            finally
            {
                try
                {
                    if (Directory.Exists(tempExtractDir))
                        Directory.Delete(tempExtractDir, true);
                }
                catch { }
            }

            LoadSelectedServerPaks();
            if (processedCount > 0)
            {
                ShowThemedMessage("Success", "Successfully processed " + processedCount + " .pak file(s) for server '" + serverName + "'.");
            }
        }

        private void ShowReadmeWindow(string title, string content)
        {
            Form readmeForm = new Form
            {
                Text = "Mod Instructions - " + title,
                Width = 500,
                Height = 450,
                StartPosition = FormStartPosition.CenterParent,
                MinimizeBox = false,
                MaximizeBox = false
            };

            TextBox txtContent = new TextBox
            {
                Multiline = true,
                ReadOnly = true,
                ScrollBars = ScrollBars.Vertical,
                Dock = DockStyle.Fill,
                Text = content,
                Font = new Font(FontFamily.GenericMonospace, 9.5f)
            };

            Button btnOk = new ShinyButton
            {
                Text = "OK (Press Enter)",
                Dock = DockStyle.Bottom,
                Height = 35,
                DialogResult = DialogResult.OK
            };
            btnOk.Click += delegate(object s, EventArgs e) { readmeForm.Close(); };

            readmeForm.Controls.Add(txtContent);
            readmeForm.Controls.Add(btnOk);
            readmeForm.AcceptButton = btnOk;

            ApplyDialogTheme(readmeForm);
            ApplyNativeScrollbarTheme(txtContent, GetThemeColors(CurrentThemeName()).UseDarkScrollbar);
            readmeForm.ShowDialog(this);
        }

        private void ProcessEngineIni(string newIniPath)
        {
            try
            {
                string targetEngineIniPath;
                if (!EnsureEngineIniExists(out targetEngineIniPath))
                {
                    return;
                }

                string targetIniDir = Path.GetDirectoryName(targetEngineIniPath);
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(targetIniDir) && !Directory.Exists(targetIniDir))
                {
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(targetIniDir);
                }

                if (File.Exists(targetEngineIniPath))
                {
                    File.SetAttributes(targetEngineIniPath, FileAttributes.Normal);
                }

                Dictionary<string, string> existingSettings = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
                List<string> existingLines = new List<string>();

                if (File.Exists(targetEngineIniPath))
                {
                    existingLines = new List<string>(File.ReadAllLines(targetEngineIniPath));
                    foreach (string line in existingLines)
                    {
                        string trimmed = line.Trim();
                        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(trimmed) && !trimmed.StartsWith(";") && !trimmed.StartsWith("#") && trimmed.Contains("="))
                        {
                            int idx = trimmed.IndexOf('=');
                            string key = trimmed.Substring(0, idx).Trim();
                            string val = trimmed.Substring(idx + 1).Trim();
                            existingSettings[key] = val;
                        }
                    }
                }

                Dictionary<string, string> incomingSettings = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
                List<string> incomingLines = new List<string>(File.ReadAllLines(newIniPath));
                foreach (string line in incomingLines)
                {
                    string trimmed = line.Trim();
                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(trimmed) && !trimmed.StartsWith(";") && !trimmed.StartsWith("#") && trimmed.Contains("="))
                    {
                        int idx = trimmed.IndexOf('=');
                        string key = trimmed.Substring(0, idx).Trim();
                        string val = trimmed.Substring(idx + 1).Trim();
                        incomingSettings[key] = val;
                    }
                }

                List<string> mergedLines = new List<string>(existingLines);
                System.Text.StringBuilder comparisonLog = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
                comparisonLog.AppendLine("Engine.ini Smart Merge Analysis:\n");

                foreach (var kvp in incomingSettings)
                {
                    string key = kvp.Key;
                    string incomingValStr = kvp.Value;

                    if (existingSettings.ContainsKey(key))
                    {
                        string existingValStr = existingSettings[key];

                        if (key.IndexOf("winch", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0 || 
                            key.IndexOf("length", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0 ||
                            key.IndexOf("rope", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0)
                        {
                            float incNum, extNum;
                            if (float.TryParse(incomingValStr, out incNum) && float.TryParse(existingValStr, out extNum))
                            {
                                if (incNum > extNum)
                                {
                                    comparisonLog.AppendLine("[WINCH / LENGTH] " + key + ":\n  Existing: " + existingValStr + "\n  Incoming: " + incomingValStr + "\n  -> Updated to larger value (" + incomingValStr + ")\n");
                                    UpdateOrCreateLine(mergedLines, key, incomingValStr);
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    comparisonLog.AppendLine("[WINCH / LENGTH] " + key + ":\n  Existing: " + existingValStr + "\n  Incoming: " + incomingValStr + "\n  -> Kept larger existing value (" + existingValStr + ")\n");
                                }
                                continue;
                            }
                        }

                        if (existingValStr != incomingValStr)
                        {
                            comparisonLog.AppendLine("[MODIFIED] " + key + ":\n  Existing: " + existingValStr + "\n  Incoming: " + incomingValStr + "\n");
                            UpdateOrCreateLine(mergedLines, key, incomingValStr);
                        }
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        comparisonLog.AppendLine("[NEW] " + key + " = " + incomingValStr + "\n");
                        mergedLines.Add(key + "=" + incomingValStr);
                    }
                }

                Form diffForm = new Form
                {
                    Text = "Engine.ini Changes Approval",
                    Width = 550,
                    Height = 480,
                    StartPosition = FormStartPosition.CenterParent,
                    MinimizeBox = false,
                    MaximizeBox = false
                };

                Label lblHeader = new Label
                {
                    Text = "A mod included an Engine.ini file. Review proposed changes below:",
                    Dock = DockStyle.Top,
                    Height = 25,
                    TextAlign = ContentAlignment.MiddleLeft,
                    Font = new Font(FontFamily.GenericSansSerif, 9, FontStyle.Bold)
                };

                TextBox txtDiff = new TextBox
                {
                    Multiline = true,
                    ReadOnly = true,
                    ScrollBars = ScrollBars.Vertical,
                    Dock = DockStyle.Fill,
                    Text = comparisonLog.ToString(),
                    Font = new Font(FontFamily.GenericMonospace, 9)
                };

                Panel pnlButtons = new Panel { Dock = DockStyle.Bottom, Height = 40 };
                Button btnApprove = new ShinyButton { Text = "Approve Edits", DialogResult = DialogResult.Yes, Width = 150, Height = 30, Location = new Point(105, 5) };
                Button btnCancel = new ShinyButton { Text = "Skip Edits", DialogResult = DialogResult.No, Width = 150, Height = 30, Location = new Point(285, 5) };

                pnlButtons.Controls.Add(btnApprove);
                pnlButtons.Controls.Add(btnCancel);

                diffForm.Controls.Add(txtDiff);
                diffForm.Controls.Add(lblHeader);
                diffForm.Controls.Add(pnlButtons);
                diffForm.AcceptButton = btnApprove;
                diffForm.CancelButton = btnCancel;

                ApplyDialogTheme(diffForm);
                ApplyNativeScrollbarTheme(txtDiff, GetThemeColors(CurrentThemeName()).UseDarkScrollbar);
                if (diffForm.ShowDialog(this) == DialogResult.Yes)
                {
                    File.WriteAllLines(targetEngineIniPath, mergedLines);
                    File.SetAttributes(targetEngineIniPath, FileAttributes.ReadOnly);

                    ShowThemedMessage("Success", "Engine.ini successfully updated, merged, and locked as Read-Only.");
                }
                else
                {
                    if (File.Exists(targetEngineIniPath))
                    {
                        File.SetAttributes(targetEngineIniPath, FileAttributes.ReadOnly);
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                ShowError("Processing Engine.ini Configuration", ex);
            }
        }

        private void UpdateOrCreateLine(List<string> lines, string key, string newValue)
        {
            bool found = false;
            for (int i = 0; i < lines.Count; i++)
            {
                string trimmed = lines[i].Trim();
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(trimmed) && !trimmed.StartsWith(";") && trimmed.StartsWith(key, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    int idx = trimmed.IndexOf('=');
                    if (idx != -1 && trimmed.Substring(0, idx).Trim().Equals(key, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        lines[i] = key + "=" + newValue;
                        found = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!found)
            {
                lines.Add(key + "=" + newValue);
            }
        }

        private void OnOpenEngineIniClicked(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            string targetEngineIniPath;
            if (!EnsureEngineIniExists(out targetEngineIniPath))
            {
                return;
            }

            try
            {
                string targetIniDir = Path.GetDirectoryName(targetEngineIniPath);
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(targetIniDir) && !Directory.Exists(targetIniDir))
                {
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(targetIniDir);
                }

                if (File.Exists(targetEngineIniPath))
                {
                    File.SetAttributes(targetEngineIniPath, FileAttributes.Normal);
                }
                else
                {
                    File.WriteAllText(targetEngineIniPath, "; Motor Town Engine.ini Config\n");
                }

                string selectedEditor = (cboEditorSelector.SelectedItem != null) ? cboEditorSelector.SelectedItem.ToString() : "Windows Notepad";
                
                if (selectedEditor.Equals("Notepad++", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    string nppPath = @"C:\Program Files\Notepad++\notepad++.exe";
                    if (!File.Exists(nppPath)) nppPath = @"C:\Program Files (x86)\Notepad++\notepad++.exe";
                    
                    if (File.Exists(nppPath))
                    {
                        Process.Start(nppPath, "\"" + targetEngineIniPath + "\"");
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        ShowThemedMessage("Editor Not Found", "Notepad++ executable could not be found in standard paths. Falling back to Windows Notepad.");
                        Process.Start("notepad.exe", targetEngineIniPath);
                    }
                }
                else if (selectedEditor.Equals("VS Code", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    string codePath = Path.Combine(Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData), @"Programs\Microsoft VS Code\Code.exe");
                    if (!File.Exists(codePath)) codePath = @"C:\Program Files\Microsoft VS Code\Code.exe";

                    if (File.Exists(codePath))
                    {
                        Process.Start(codePath, "\"" + targetEngineIniPath + "\"");
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        ShowThemedMessage("Editor Not Found", "VS Code executable could not be found in standard paths. Falling back to Windows Notepad.");
                        Process.Start("notepad.exe", targetEngineIniPath);
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    Process.Start("notepad.exe", targetEngineIniPath);
                }
                
                ShowThemedMessage("Engine.ini Unlocked", "Engine.ini has been unlocked for editing.\n\nClick OK once you are finished editing to lock it back to Read-Only automatically.");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                ShowError("Opening Engine.ini", ex);
            }
            finally
            {
                try
                {
                    if (File.Exists(targetEngineIniPath))
                    {
                        File.SetAttributes(targetEngineIniPath, FileAttributes.ReadOnly);
                    }
                }
                catch { }
            }
        }

        private void OnDeployModsClicked(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            string serverName = (cboServerDropdown.SelectedItem != null) ? cboServerDropdown.SelectedItem.ToString() : null;
            string gamePath = txtGamePath.Text;

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(serverName))
            {
                ShowThemedMessage("Error", "Please select or create a server first.");
                return;
            }

            if (!Directory.Exists(gamePath))
            {
                ShowThemedMessage("Error", "Target game directory does not exist.");
                return;
            }

            if (ShowThemedConfirm("Deploy Mods", "This will clear out existing mod paks in your game folder and deploy '" + serverName + "' mods.\n\nProceed?") != DialogResult.Yes)
                return;

            try
            {
                foreach (string pak in Directory.GetFiles(gamePath, "*.pak"))
                {
                    if (!Path.GetFileName(pak).Equals("MotorTown-Windows.pak", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        File.Delete(pak);
                    }
                }

                string sourceDir = Path.Combine(serverStorageDir, serverName);
                int deployedCount = 0;

                foreach (string pak in Directory.GetFiles(sourceDir, "*.pak"))
                {
                    File.Copy(pak, Path.Combine(gamePath, Path.GetFileName(pak)), true);
                    deployedCount++;
                }

                ShowThemedMessage("Success", "Successfully deployed " + deployedCount + " mod file(s) from server '" + serverName + "'.");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                ShowError("Deploying Mods to Game Directory", ex);
            }
        }

        private void OnRevertVanillaClicked(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            string gamePath = txtGamePath.Text;

            if (!Directory.Exists(gamePath))
            {
                ShowThemedMessage("Error", "Target game directory does not exist.");
                return;
            }

            if (ShowThemedConfirm("Revert to Vanilla", "This will remove all installed mods from your game folder and restore vanilla configuration.\n\nProceed?") != DialogResult.Yes)
                return;

            try
            {
                int removedCount = 0;
                foreach (string pak in Directory.GetFiles(gamePath, "*.pak"))
                {
                    if (!Path.GetFileName(pak).Equals("MotorTown-Windows.pak", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        File.Delete(pak);
                        removedCount++;
                    }
                }

                ShowThemedMessage("Success", "Successfully removed " + removedCount + " mod file(s). Game restored to clean vanilla state.");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                ShowError("Removing Mods from Game Directory", ex);
            }
        }

        private async void OnBackupPaksClicked(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            string gamePath = txtGamePath.Text;

            if (!Directory.Exists(gamePath))
            {
                ShowThemedMessage("Error", "Target game directory does not exist.");
                return;
            }

            string sourceFile = Path.Combine(gamePath, "MotorTown-Windows.pak");

            if (!File.Exists(sourceFile))
            {
                ShowThemedMessage("Backup Failed", "Could not find 'MotorTown-Windows.pak' in the target game directory.");
                return;
            }

            ShowBusyOverlay("Backing up MotorTown-Windows.pak...");
            try
            {
                if (!Directory.Exists(backupStorageDir))
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(backupStorageDir);

                string destFile = Path.Combine(backupStorageDir, "MotorTown-Windows.pak");

                // This file is large enough that a synchronous File.Copy on the UI thread
                // would freeze the whole window for the duration - running it on a
                // background thread keeps the app responsive while the overlay spins.
                await Task.Run(delegate { File.Copy(sourceFile, destFile, true); });

                ShowThemedMessage("Backup Complete", "Successfully backed up 'MotorTown-Windows.pak' to 'ServerMods\\Backup_Vanilla'.");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                ShowError("Backing Up Game Pak", ex);
            }
            finally
            {
                HideBusyOverlay();
            }
        }

        private async void OnRestoreBackupClicked(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            string gamePath = txtGamePath.Text;

            if (!Directory.Exists(gamePath))
            {
                ShowThemedMessage("Error", "Target game directory does not exist.");
                return;
            }

            string sourceBackupFile = Path.Combine(backupStorageDir, "MotorTown-Windows.pak");

            if (!File.Exists(sourceBackupFile))
            {
                ShowThemedMessage("No Backup Found", "No backup file found for 'MotorTown-Windows.pak' inside 'ServerMods\\Backup_Vanilla'. Please run 'Backup Main Game File' first.");
                return;
            }

            if (ShowThemedConfirm("Restore Backup", "This will overwrite your current game core package ('MotorTown-Windows.pak') with your saved backup version. Proceed?") != DialogResult.Yes)
                return;

            ShowBusyOverlay("Restoring MotorTown-Windows.pak...");
            try
            {
                string destFile = Path.Combine(gamePath, "MotorTown-Windows.pak");
                await Task.Run(delegate { File.Copy(sourceBackupFile, destFile, true); });

                ShowThemedMessage("Restore Complete", "Successfully restored 'MotorTown-Windows.pak' from backup.");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                ShowError("Restoring Game Pak from Backup", ex);
            }
            finally
            {
                HideBusyOverlay();
            }
        }

        private void OnBackupSavesClicked(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            string charactersDir = Path.Combine(Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData), @"MotorTown\Saved\SaveGames\Characters");

            if (!Directory.Exists(charactersDir))
            {
                ShowThemedMessage("Backup Failed", "Characters save directory could not be found at:\n" + charactersDir);
                return;
            }

            try
            {
                if (!Directory.Exists(saveGameBackupDir))
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(saveGameBackupDir);

                string[] saveFiles = Directory.GetFiles(charactersDir, "*.sav");
                int backedUpCount = 0;

                foreach (string file in saveFiles)
                {
                    string fileName = Path.GetFileName(file);
                    if (Regex.IsMatch(fileName, @"backup\d+", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase))
                    {
                        continue;
                    }

                    string destFile = Path.Combine(saveGameBackupDir, fileName);
                    File.Copy(file, destFile, true);
                    backedUpCount++;
                }

                ShowThemedMessage("Backup Complete", "Successfully backed up " + backedUpCount + " character save file(s) to 'ServerMods\\Backup_Saves'.");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                ShowError("Backing Up Character Saves", ex);
            }
        }

        private void OnManageSavesClicked(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            string charactersLiveDir = Path.Combine(Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData), @"MotorTown\Saved\SaveGames\Characters");
            
            if (!Directory.Exists(saveGameBackupDir) || Directory.GetFiles(saveGameBackupDir, "*.sav").Length == 0)
            {
                ShowThemedMessage("No Saves Backed Up", "No saved character backups found in 'ServerMods\\Backup_Saves'. Please run 'Backup Character Saves' first.");
                return;
            }

            Form manageForm = new Form
            {
                Text = "Manage / Restore Character Saves",
                Width = 480,
                Height = 460,
                StartPosition = FormStartPosition.CenterParent,
                MinimizeBox = false,
                MaximizeBox = false
            };

            Label lblInfo = new Label
            {
                Text = "Select character saves to restore to game\nor delete from backup storage:",
                Location = new Point(15, 15),
                AutoSize = false,
                Size = new Size(435, 40),
                Font = new Font(FontFamily.GenericSansSerif, 9, FontStyle.Bold),
                Anchor = AnchorStyles.Top | AnchorStyles.Left | AnchorStyles.Right
            };

            CheckedListBox chkListSaves = new CheckedListBox
            {
                Location = new Point(15, 60),
                Size = new Size(435, 285),
                CheckOnClick = true,
                Anchor = AnchorStyles.Top | AnchorStyles.Bottom | AnchorStyles.Left | AnchorStyles.Right
            };

            foreach (string file in Directory.GetFiles(saveGameBackupDir, "*.sav"))
            {
                string fileName = Path.GetFileName(file);
                chkListSaves.Items.Add(fileName, true);
            }

            Button btnRestoreSelected = new ShinyButton
            {
                Text = "Restore Selected Saves",
                Location = new Point(15, 355),
                Width = 215,
                Height = 38,
                FlatStyle = FlatStyle.Flat,
                Anchor = AnchorStyles.Bottom | AnchorStyles.Left,
                Font = new Font(FontFamily.GenericSansSerif, 8.5f, FontStyle.Bold)
            };

            Button btnDeleteSelectedSaves = new ShinyButton
            {
                Text = "Delete Selected Saves",
                Location = new Point(238, 355),
                Width = 215,
                Height = 38,
                FlatStyle = FlatStyle.Flat,
                Anchor = AnchorStyles.Bottom | AnchorStyles.Right,
                Font = new Font(FontFamily.GenericSansSerif, 8.5f, FontStyle.Bold)
            };

            btnRestoreSelected.Click += delegate
            {
                if (chkListSaves.CheckedItems.Count == 0)
                {
                    ShowThemedMessage("Notice", "Please check at least one save file to restore.");
                    return;
                }

                if (!Directory.Exists(charactersLiveDir))
                {
                    try { Directory.CreateDirectory(charactersLiveDir); }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        ShowError("Creating Live Characters Directory", ex);
                        return;
                    }
                }

                if (ShowThemedConfirm("Confirm Restore", "Are you sure you want to restore the selected character save(s) to your active game files?") != DialogResult.Yes)
                    return;

                try
                {
                    int restored = 0;
                    foreach (var item in chkListSaves.CheckedItems)
                    {
                        string fileName = item.ToString();
                        string src = Path.Combine(saveGameBackupDir, fileName);
                        string dest = Path.Combine(charactersLiveDir, fileName);
                        File.Copy(src, dest, true);
                        restored++;
                    }

                    ShowThemedMessage("Restore Complete", "Successfully restored " + restored + " character save file(s) to the game directory.");
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    ShowError("Restoring Character Saves", ex);
                }
            };

            btnDeleteSelectedSaves.Click += delegate
            {
                if (chkListSaves.CheckedItems.Count == 0)
                {
                    ShowThemedMessage("Notice", "Please check at least one save file to delete.");
                    return;
                }

                string confirmationInput = ShowThemedInputBox("To permanently delete the selected save backup(s), type 'delete' below:", "Confirm Deletion", "");
                if (!confirmationInput.Trim().Equals("delete", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    ShowThemedMessage("Cancelled", "Deletion cancelled. You must type 'delete' correctly to confirm.");
                    return;
                }

                try
                {
                    int deleted = 0;
                    List<object> itemsToRemove = new List<object>();
                    foreach (var item in chkListSaves.CheckedItems)
                    {
                        string fileName = item.ToString();
                        string targetPath = Path.Combine(saveGameBackupDir, fileName);
                        if (File.Exists(targetPath))
                        {
                            File.Delete(targetPath);
                            deleted++;
                            itemsToRemove.Add(item);
                        }
                    }

                    foreach (var item in itemsToRemove)
                    {
                        chkListSaves.Items.Remove(item);
                    }

                    ShowThemedMessage("Deleted", "Successfully deleted " + deleted + " save backup file(s).");
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    ShowError("Deleting Character Saves", ex);
                }
            };

            manageForm.Controls.Add(lblInfo);
            manageForm.Controls.Add(chkListSaves);
            manageForm.Controls.Add(btnRestoreSelected);
            manageForm.Controls.Add(btnDeleteSelectedSaves);

            ApplyDialogTheme(manageForm);
            ApplyNativeScrollbarTheme(chkListSaves, GetThemeColors(CurrentThemeName()).UseDarkScrollbar);
            manageForm.ShowDialog(this);
        }

        private void OnLaunchGameClicked(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            try
            {
                Process.Start("steam://rungameid/1369670");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                ShowError("Launch Motor Town via Steam", ex);
            }
        }
    }

    // Custom-drawn button with a glossy, slightly 3D look: a top-to-bottom gradient body,
    // a soft highlight band near the top to fake a glass/shine reflection, a subtle border,
    // and distinct hover/pressed states. FlatStyle is forced to Flat with no built-in border
    // so this OnPaint override is the only thing responsible for drawing the button.
    // Plain Panel is not double-buffered by default, so repeatedly invalidating one for a
    // custom-painted animation (like the busy spinner) visibly flickers. DoubleBuffered is
    // only protected on Control, so it can only be set from inside a class that inherits
    // from it - hence this tiny subclass instead of setting it from the Form.
    public class DoubleBufferedPanel : Panel
    {
        public DoubleBufferedPanel()
        {
            SetStyle(ControlStyles.AllPaintingInWmPaint | ControlStyles.UserPaint | ControlStyles.OptimizedDoubleBuffer, true);
        }
    }

    // Small hand-drawn vector icon set for Console Mode's sidebar tabs and tiles - built from
    // plain GDI+ primitives (lines/arcs/rectangles/ellipses) instead of shipping image assets,
    // so every icon is a single monochrome outline that automatically matches whatever
    // ForeColor/theme accent color the button carrying it is currently drawn in.
    public enum ConsoleIconKind
    {
        None, Mods, Servers, Backups, Utility,
        AddPlus, Trash, DeployBox, Refresh, Undo, Redo, ResizeUpDown,
        Merge, Save, Restore, Folder, File, Gear, Discord
    }

    public static class ConsoleIcons
    {
        public static void Paint(ConsoleIconKind kind, Graphics g, RectangleF r, Color c)
        {
            if (kind == ConsoleIconKind.None) return;

            System.Drawing.Drawing2D.SmoothingMode prevSmoothing = g.SmoothingMode;
            g.SmoothingMode = System.Drawing.Drawing2D.SmoothingMode.AntiAlias;

            using (Pen pen = new Pen(c, Math.Max(1.4f, r.Width * 0.09f))
            {
                LineJoin = System.Drawing.Drawing2D.LineJoin.Round,
                StartCap = System.Drawing.Drawing2D.LineCap.Round,
                EndCap = System.Drawing.Drawing2D.LineCap.Round
            })
            using (SolidBrush brush = new SolidBrush(c))
            {
                switch (kind)
                {
                    case ConsoleIconKind.Mods: PaintMods(g, r, pen); break;
                    case ConsoleIconKind.Servers: PaintServers(g, r, pen, brush); break;
                    case ConsoleIconKind.Backups: PaintSave(g, r, pen); break;
                    case ConsoleIconKind.Utility: PaintGear(g, r, pen); break;
                    case ConsoleIconKind.AddPlus: PaintPlus(g, r, pen); break;
                    case ConsoleIconKind.Trash: PaintTrash(g, r, pen); break;
                    case ConsoleIconKind.DeployBox: PaintBoxArrow(g, r, pen, true); break;
                    case ConsoleIconKind.Refresh: PaintRefresh(g, r, pen); break;
                    case ConsoleIconKind.Undo: PaintUndo(g, r, pen); break;
                    case ConsoleIconKind.Redo: PaintRedo(g, r, pen); break;
                    case ConsoleIconKind.ResizeUpDown: PaintResize(g, r, pen); break;
                    case ConsoleIconKind.Merge: PaintMerge(g, r, pen); break;
                    case ConsoleIconKind.Save: PaintSave(g, r, pen); break;
                    case ConsoleIconKind.Restore: PaintBoxArrow(g, r, pen, false); break;
                    case ConsoleIconKind.Folder: PaintFolder(g, r, pen); break;
                    case ConsoleIconKind.File: PaintFile(g, r, pen); break;
                    case ConsoleIconKind.Gear: PaintGear(g, r, pen); break;
                    case ConsoleIconKind.Discord: PaintDiscord(g, r, pen, brush); break;
                }
            }

            g.SmoothingMode = prevSmoothing;
        }

        // Three overlapping "pak" cards stepped diagonally - a stack of mods.
        private static void PaintMods(Graphics g, RectangleF r, Pen pen)
        {
            float w = r.Width * 0.6f, h = r.Height * 0.4f;
            float stepX = r.Width * 0.16f, stepY = r.Height * 0.16f;
            for (int i = 2; i >= 0; i--)
            {
                g.DrawRectangle(pen, r.X + i * stepX, r.Bottom - h - i * stepY, w, h);
            }
        }

        // Three stacked server rows, each with a little status LED on the right.
        private static void PaintServers(Graphics g, RectangleF r, Pen pen, SolidBrush brush)
        {
            float rowH = r.Height / 3.6f;
            float gap = rowH * 0.3f;
            float y = r.Y;
            for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
            {
                g.DrawRectangle(pen, r.X, y, r.Width, rowH);
                float dotR = rowH * 0.24f;
                g.FillEllipse(brush, r.Right - dotR * 2.4f, y + (rowH - dotR) / 2f, dotR, dotR);
                y += rowH + gap;
            }
        }

        // Floppy-disk silhouette: outer square, a notch cut from the top-right, a label
        // rectangle in the lower half - reused for both "Backups" and individual save icons.
        private static void PaintSave(Graphics g, RectangleF r, Pen pen)
        {
            g.DrawRectangle(pen, r.X, r.Y, r.Width, r.Height);
            g.DrawRectangle(pen, r.X + r.Width * 0.55f, r.Y, r.Width * 0.45f, r.Height * 0.35f);
            g.DrawRectangle(pen, r.X + r.Width * 0.2f, r.Y + r.Height * 0.5f, r.Width * 0.6f, r.Height * 0.35f);
        }

        // Same gear glyph used for the corner Settings icon (SettingsGear_Paint), generalized
        // to scale with whatever rectangle it's given instead of a fixed 24x24 spot.
        //
        // This used to be 8 thin lines radiating out of a small circle, which at icon size
        // reads as a sun/asterisk rather than a gear. A real gear silhouette needs teeth with
        // actual width (a flat tip, angled sides down to the root circle) rather than
        // zero-width spokes, so this builds that shape as a single closed polygon (tip-left,
        // tip-right, valley, repeat) plus a hub circle in the middle.
        private static void PaintGear(Graphics g, RectangleF r, Pen pen)
        {
            float cx = r.X + r.Width / 2f, cy = r.Y + r.Height / 2f;
            float outerR = r.Width / 2f;
            float rootR = outerR * 0.66f;
            float hubR = outerR * 0.32f;
            const int teeth = 8;
            const float step = 360f / teeth;
            const float toothHalfAngle = step * 0.3f;

            var pts = new List<PointF>(teeth * 3);
            for (int i = 0; i < teeth; i++)
            {
                float center = i * step;
                pts.Add(GearPoint(cx, cy, rootR, center - step / 2f));
                pts.Add(GearPoint(cx, cy, outerR, center - toothHalfAngle));
                pts.Add(GearPoint(cx, cy, outerR, center + toothHalfAngle));
            }

            g.DrawPolygon(pen, pts.ToArray());
            g.DrawEllipse(pen, cx - hubR, cy - hubR, hubR * 2, hubR * 2);
        }

        private static PointF GearPoint(float cx, float cy, float radius, float angleDeg)
        {
            double rad = angleDeg * Math.PI / 180.0;
            return new PointF(cx + radius * (float)Math.Cos(rad), cy + radius * (float)Math.Sin(rad));
        }

        private static void PaintPlus(Graphics g, RectangleF r, Pen pen)
        {
            float cx = r.X + r.Width / 2f, cy = r.Y + r.Height / 2f;
            float half = Math.Min(r.Width, r.Height) * 0.4f;
            g.DrawLine(pen, cx - half, cy, cx + half, cy);
            g.DrawLine(pen, cx, cy - half, cx, cy + half);
        }

        private static void PaintTrash(Graphics g, RectangleF r, Pen pen)
        {
            float bodyTop = r.Y + r.Height * 0.3f;
            RectangleF body = new RectangleF(r.X + r.Width * 0.16f, bodyTop, r.Width * 0.68f, r.Height * 0.6f);
            g.DrawRectangle(pen, body.X, body.Y, body.Width, body.Height);
            g.DrawLine(pen, r.X + r.Width * 0.04f, bodyTop, r.Right - r.Width * 0.04f, bodyTop);
            g.DrawLine(pen, r.X + r.Width * 0.38f, r.Y, r.X + r.Width * 0.62f, r.Y);
            g.DrawLine(pen, r.X + r.Width * 0.38f, r.Y, r.X + r.Width * 0.38f, bodyTop);
            g.DrawLine(pen, r.X + r.Width * 0.62f, r.Y, r.X + r.Width * 0.62f, bodyTop);
            float lineY1 = body.Y + body.Height * 0.22f, lineY2 = body.Bottom - body.Height * 0.12f;
            g.DrawLine(pen, body.X + body.Width * 0.32f, lineY1, body.X + body.Width * 0.32f, lineY2);
            g.DrawLine(pen, body.X + body.Width * 0.68f, lineY1, body.X + body.Width * 0.68f, lineY2);
        }

        // A box with an arrow into it (deploy/install) or an arrow out of it (restore),
        // sharing one shape since they're mirror images of each other.
        private static void PaintBoxArrow(Graphics g, RectangleF r, Pen pen, bool arrowPointsDown)
        {
            RectangleF box = new RectangleF(r.X, r.Bottom - r.Height * 0.42f, r.Width, r.Height * 0.42f);
            g.DrawRectangle(pen, box.X, box.Y, box.Width, box.Height);
            float cx = r.X + r.Width / 2f;
            float farY = r.Y, nearY = box.Y - r.Height * 0.06f;
            float shaftTop = arrowPointsDown ? farY : nearY;
            float shaftBottom = arrowPointsDown ? nearY : farY;
            g.DrawLine(pen, cx, shaftTop, cx, shaftBottom);
            float headY = arrowPointsDown ? nearY : farY;
            float headSpread = arrowPointsDown ? -1f : 1f;
            g.DrawLine(pen, cx - r.Width * 0.2f, headY + headSpread * r.Height * 0.2f, cx, headY);
            g.DrawLine(pen, cx + r.Width * 0.2f, headY + headSpread * r.Height * 0.2f, cx, headY);
        }

        // Draws a solid triangular arrowhead with its tip at (tipX, tipY), pointing along
        // dirRad. Every arrow icon in the app now shares this instead of hand-drawing two
        // barb lines each: two separate DrawLine calls at hand-picked angles produced heads
        // whose barbs were often uneven, and where one barb could land almost exactly on top
        // of the curve it was attached to and effectively disappear - which is why the undo,
        // redo and refresh glyphs all looked like they only had "half a point" on them.
        private static void FillArrowHead(Graphics g, Pen pen, float tipX, float tipY, double dirRad, float size)
        {
            double leftRad = dirRad + Math.PI - Math.PI / 6.0;
            double rightRad = dirRad + Math.PI + Math.PI / 6.0;

            PointF[] head = new PointF[]
            {
